title: Decode the memo
description:
Amaka forwards you a short memo recovered from The Griot's Q2 data dump. It came through a leaky pastebin scraper, so it is wrapped in base64 before anything legible appears.

Open Cipher Tools, switch to the Base64 tab. The widget will load the base64-encoded memo into the input field — the encoding is per-intern (your flag is baked in before the encode). Decode it in the right pane and read the plaintext memo.

The decoded plaintext is a template — it includes your per-intern TRAN flag inside the memo body. Read the memo, extract that flag, and submit it.

Reference: RFC 4648 (base16/32/64 encoding).

widgetConfig.base64Plaintext: Memo from The Griot: 'Operation continues. Flag check: {FLAG}'
